retrieved.text: Travel reimbursements must be submitted within 30 days of the trip ending. Every expense over 25 dollars requires an itemized receipt. International travel needs approval from the department lead before booking.

retrieved.title: Purchasing policy
retrieved.text: Purchases above 5000 dollars require two independent approvals. Software subscriptions also need a security review before purchase. Approved vendors are reassessed every twelve months.

retrieved.text: Project working documents are retained for three years after project closure. Archived documents remain searchable until their retention deadline. Documents under a preservation hold must not be deleted until the hold is lifted.
